To add another phone, scan this code in its Den-Watcher app. Other devices are added on the hub\'s page, under Devices.

Keep this device on its charger with the battery\'s charge limit on, if it has one. Give it a fixed address on your router, and in its Wi-Fi settings use the device\'s own MAC address, so the other devices keep finding it.
This device also sends its own battery, Wi-Fi and use to the hub, as a phone of its own, once recording is on below.
